exposure: nasopharyngeal metatranscriptome profiles of infant bronchiolitis (specifically, profiles A, B, C, D, E)
microbiome composition (H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, M. nonliquefaciens, M. catarrhalis abundance)
cohort: Infants under 1 year of age who were hospitalized for bronchiolitis.
finding: The study identified five distinct metatranscriptome profiles of infant bronchiolitis, with profiles B and C showing significantly higher risks for developing asthma compared to profile A.
